entities.title: Daemon error lines
entities.summary: zazzled writes one line per problem it survives to its standard error, prefixed `zazzled: `.
entities.name: zazzled: ...
entities.meaning: A connection that failed (a peer of another uid, a malformed or oversize request, too many descriptors, a missing working directory), an accept error other than would-block, a failed cache write, or a cache that could not be opened (`cache disabled`).
entities.access: Whoever holds the daemon's standard error. A daemon the invoker or the MCP front end starts has it on /dev/null, and the LaunchAgent plist names no log file, so these lines are seen only when `zazzled serve` runs in a terminal.
excludes: Requests, file paths read and command output are not logged.
